message.Title: Public Preview: Microsoft Foundry one-click deploy channels in Teams, M365 and non-Microsoft

Body.Content: Microsoft Foundry now enables one-click, no-code publishing of custom agents to Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot. This feature removes the complexity of pro-code deployment, allowing organizations to instantly reach millions of users while maintaining compliance, security, and governance. The streamlined process accelerates adoption and unlocks new enterprise scenarios for AI agents.
